meta.register: アドレス・ベース・レジストリ (Address Base Registry)
meta.publisher: Digital Agency, Government of Japan (デジタル庁), distributed by OpenAddresses
meta.attribution: デジタル庁「アドレス・ベース・レジストリ」をOpenAddressesおよびopen-geocodeが加工
meta.notes: The OpenAddresses extract covers residential numbering (住居表示). Truth is the registry's representative point for the residence number, in JGD2011 (EPSG:6668). The town and chōme (street in the extract) and optional koaza stand in for road. Number holds the block and residence numbers. Postcodes are from the town master. The pack source openaddresses:jp/countrywide imports the same extract.
meta.draw: lowest sha256('2026:' || register id) among eligible rows

forms.messy: same, without postcode, region and country, abbreviated by OpenCage's lists

meta.truth: the register's point, converted to WGS84 by PROJ where the register uses another CRS

operations.EPSG:6668: axis order change (2D) + JGD2011 to WGS 84 (1) + axis order change (2D)
